description: This Java class defines a custom Android View called BackgroundView that draws four full-screen triangles with different colors, used as a background in a Snake game app.

classes.name: BackgroundView
classes.description: Custom View subclass that draws four colored triangles filling the background.

methods.name: BackgroundView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view and retrieves color attributes for background segments.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View method to draw triangles with assigned colors on the Canvas.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Overrides the View method to recalculate vertex points when the view size changes.
